desc: True Precision extended mag releases put superior command of your magazine swaps directly in your hands. They dramatically speed up reloads, make every change smoother and more intuitive, and deliver the effortless control you need for both fast range drills and reliable everyday carry. The striking sculpted design installs flawlessly, perfectly matches your True Precision finish, and transforms your pistol into a cohesive, head-turning custom build that looks every bit as capable as it performs.
